header.name: Introduction to Bioinspired Algorithms and Optimal Control
header.description: This course introduces bioinspired algorithms and optimal control, with a focus on applications in biological systems. We will explore optimal control problems, the limitations of classical optimization, and bioinspired approaches that address these challenges. The course emphasizes applications and numerical methods. Optimization methods will be applied to systems, including microbial growth, epidemic modeling, drug dosing strategies and ecological applications. We will cover bioinspired algorithms, focusing on genetic algorithms and swarm optimization techniques.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will learn the basics of formulating appropriate optimization problems, with an emphasis on biological phenomena.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will gain a thorough understanding of numerical schemes that can be implemented to solve optimization problems.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will learn the limitations of classical optimization algorithms and gain an insight into how biological phenomena in nature inspired several non standard algorithms.

lecture_topics: Classical approach to optimal control problems
bioinspired approach to classical problems- travelling salesman problem
